§6Manganese Oxide Dust§f

§aA processing intermediate for manganese-based materials.§f
§bManganese Oxide Dust§f is produced by processing §bManganese§f ore or dust in the §bManufactory§f. It's used in several alloy recipes and chemical processes further down the NuclearCraft chain.

Nothing fancy here, just another dust to keep your processing lines running. Process it in the §bAlloy Furnace§f or §bChemical Reactor§f depending on what you're making. Manganese itself comes from standard ore processing, so you'll naturally accumulate this as you mine.

§ePS:§f Check JEI to see what recipes use Manganese Oxide. It shows up in more places than you'd expect, especially in advanced alloy blends and chemical intermediates.
